edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier restricts transferOwnership to msg.sender == owner.
owner state variable read in the onlyOwner authorization check.
_newOwner parameter is written into newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
newOwner is the authorization value checked in acceptOwnership.
acceptOwnership sets owner = newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
pause is guarded by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
owner compared against msg.sender inside pause.
pause sets paused = true.
unpause is guarded by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
owner compared against msg.sender inside unpause.
unpause sets paused = false.
ROD constructor sets _totalSupply = 10000000 * 10**decimals.
ROD constructor credits the whole supply to balances[owner].
_totalSupply value is assigned into balances[owner].
transfer is invoked by msg.sender and operates on balances[msg.sender].
transfer reads the caller and recipient balances from the balances mapping.
transfer writes updated balances back into the balances mapping.
tokens amount is subtracted from sender and added to recipient balances.
to address is used as the key into the balances mapping.
whenNotPaused modifier reads the paused flag before executing transfer.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub for balance decrement.
transfer uses SafeMath.add for balance increment.
approve is called by msg.sender and indexes allowed[msg.sender].
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
spender parameter keys the second dimension of allowed.
tokens parameter is the value stored in allowed.
whenNotPaused reads paused in approve.
increaseApproval writes the increased allowance back to allowed.
_spender keys the second dimension of allowed.
_addedValue is added into the stored allowance.
increaseApproval uses SafeMath.add on the allowance.
whenNotPaused reads paused in increaseApproval.
decreaseApproval writes the decreased allowance back to allowed.
oldValue caches allowed[msg.sender][_spender] before it is overwritten.
decreaseApproval performs oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue).
_subtractedValue is compared against the oldValue local.
whenNotPaused reads paused in decreaseApproval.
from address keys the balances mapping in transferFrom.
tokens amount is moved between balances entries in transferFrom.
transferFrom updates balances of both parties.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
msg.sender indexes the allowance in allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
whenNotPaused reads paused in transferFrom.
tokenOwner keys the first dimension of allowed.
spender keys the second dimension of allowed.
allowance returns the value stored in the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall invokes the external receiveApproval function on the spender contract.
The untrusted external call can call back into the token contract before returning.
spender parameter is the attacker-controlled target of the external call.
approveAndCall is invoked by msg.sender and sets its allowance.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token's transfer.
tokenAddress parameter is the untrusted target of the external call.
onlyOwner restricts transferAnyERC20Token.
msg.sender must equal owner before the external token transfer is made.
totalSupply computes _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] without SafeMath.
_totalSupply is an operand of the unchecked subtraction.
balances[address(0)] is the other operand of the unchecked subtraction.
burn subtracts the burned amount from the caller's balance.
burn reduces _totalSupply.
_value parameter determines the balance decrement in burn.
burn uses SafeMath.sub for balance and supply reductions.
burn checks msg.sender balance and is owner-restricted.
burn is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
tokenOwner keys the balances mapping in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads and returns balances[tokenOwner].
fallback function receives any plain call and reverts.
